answer: Reputation drag with delayed disclosure. Each identity earns a willow score from completed work, but the operator’s payout address is linked to all identities it funds through a quartz deposit trail that settles only after 30 days. If any one identity is flagged for sybil behavior, the operator’s entire pending settlement enters a spiral penalty that forfeits 100% of escrowed funds across every linked identity, not just the flagged wallet. An attacker must therefore front real capital and real work output for 30 days per identity, with full correlated loss on any single detection.
